history.name: DataVerification_Expert
history.content:
Implementing weighted calculation:
```python
fruits = [
    "Dehydrated Apples", "Dehydrated Apricots", "Dehydrated Peaches", "Dehydrated Pears", "Dehydrated Prunes",
    "Frozen Apples", "Frozen Apricots", "Frozen Peaches", "Frozen Pears", "Frozen Prunes"
]
vegetables = [i for i in items_extended if i not in fruits]

sup_fruit = sum(1 for i in fruits if (withdrawn_flags.get(i, False) or latest_year_ext.get(i, 1959) > 1959))
sup_veg = sum(1 for i in vegetables if (withdrawn_flags.get(i, False) or latest_year_ext.get(i, 1959) > 1959))
ratio_fruit = sup_fruit / len(fruits)
ratio_veg = sup_veg / len(vegetables)
weighted = round((0.6 * ratio_fruit + 0.4 * ratio_veg) * 100)
print("Weighted supersession %:", weighted)
```
